initial:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity Chinese desktop mortgage comparison TOOL PAGE design, tall portrait 1200x1900 approximate. Reference image is only art direction: warm ivory, restrained vermilion, olive, elegant serif headlines, black sans serif body, fine rules, open uncluttered layout, personal wordmark 张本人. Do NOT recreate homepage sections. Header 张本人, 工具 笔记 联系 EN. Title 房贷方案比较, subtitle 同一笔贷款，看清月供与利息的变化。 
Top compact common input 本金 5,000 万日元. Two side by side scenario controls A 元利均等 red solid line marker / 年利率 1.5% / 期限 30年; B 元金均等 olive dashed marker / 年利率 1.5% / 期限 30年. Scope 固定利率 · 按月还款 · 不含费用. Small presets 比较还款方式 / 比较利率 / 比较期限.
THREE stacked FULL WIDTH synchronized charts, same horizontal scale 0 to 30 years, never a separate chart per scenario. Each chart clear labeled and generous. First chart 月供比较: y axis 万日元/月 ticks14,16,18,20, x years 0 5 10 15 20 25 30. Red A horizontal at17.26, dashed olive B descending straight from20.14 to13.91. Curves intersect approximately46% across chart, red circled intersection with dotted vertical guide aligned in all three charts. Annotation concise 第168期起，B月供更低. Small text under chart 交点仅表示月供高低反转. Light unobtrusive interval labels left A月供较低 and right B月供较低. No label says better or cheaper overall.
Second chart 每月利息: segmented control 两方案 | 当月差额 A−B. Default two curves: both start same6.25 万日元/月, olive dashed straight decreases toward0, red remains above olive during loan and decreases concave downward toward0. Same dotted time guide as first. Legend consistent A red B olive. No middle crossing between interest curves.
Third chart 累计利息差: segmented control 累计差额 A−B | 两方案累计利息 | 剩余本金. Default SINGLE red line starts at0 and increases monotonically with flattened slopes near endpoints, finishes at84.04万日元; axis 万日元. Zero baseline. Annotation 全期 A 比 B 多付约84.04万日元利息. Same dotted guide. Clearly small subtitle 正值表示 A 累计利息更多. Do not draw a fake crossover on this chart.
Below diagrams elegant small result strip A总利息 1,212.16万日元 / B总利息 1,128.13万日元. Plain explanatory paragraph 月供更低，不等于累计成本更低。解释时还要看已付利息与剩余本金。 Red outlined button 查看还款明细 and small optional button 解释当前比较; adjacent badge 示例解释 · AI未连接.
Bottom understated closed disclosure rows 基本概念 / 公式与计算假设 / 利率资料与引用 / 变动利率规则. Footer © 2026 Ziliang Zhang.
Keep excellent Chinese text readability, clear chart units and geometry. All numbers provided computed for no rounding per period scenario. Render design mockup, not financial marketing, no fake bank logos, no shiny dashboard, no large cards or gradients. Main goal make it obvious TWO scenarios are compared INSIDE EACH chart, while DIFFERENT METRICS are separated into three charts.
correction: Correct this same mortgage tool design image only: bottom cumulative difference red curve MUST be monotonically increasing from zero to84.04, NEVER decline anywhere, gentle S shape with almost horizontal tangent at start and end. This is mathematically essential. The month interest red curve should be closer to olive: at15years red about3.5 olive3.125, both start6.25, finish close to0. All dotted vertical guides align EXACTLY with the circled monthly-payment intersection near13.9years, not at11.7years. Remove decorative section number prefixes 1. 2. 3. Keep section titles. Keep every other text, layout, numeric result, colors and controls identical.
